data.name: Nasik
data.gender_notes: Nasik is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Nasaka' which means 'to support' or 'to help'. This name is mentioned in the Hadith as the name of one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who supported him during the Battle of Uhud. The name Nasik carries the meaning “Supporter or Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasik usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter or helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a faithful supporter of truth and justice.
data.etymology: Nasik belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter or Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasik total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
